scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=huong-thien-nature-web --branch=main
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:worker-dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
